title: AdvancedModels - Modern Wooden Bench
description: A high-quality 3D bench model for AdvancedModels plugin, featuring custom colors and sitting interaction.
body:
🪑 Modern Wooden Bench | AdvancedModels
A high-quality, 3D wooden bench model designed specifically for Minecraft servers using the AdvancedModels plugin. This model is perfect for adding a touch of realism and comfort to your spawns, parks, or player homes.

✨ Features:
3D Detailed Design: Built with precision in Blockbench to maintain the Minecraft aesthetic.

Interaction Ready: Fully compatible with the SIT feature.

Color Variants: Includes configuration for multiple wood types (Brown, Dark Oak, and Black).

Optimized: Low poly design to ensure no lag on your server.

🛠️ Installation & Requirements:
Requirement: You must have the AdvancedModels plugin installed on your server.

Upload: Place the provided bench.bbmodel and model.yml into your AdvancedModels folder.

Reload: Use /amodal reload and spawn your bench!
